The answer depends on the medium. In the Smallville TV series, Lois's love for Clark is first revealed in Season 8, Episode 5 "Committed" [d2], and they officially start dating in Season 9, with their first real romantic kiss occurring in Season 9, Episode 6 "Crossfire" [d4][d7]. By Season 9, Clark shows his true feelings at the Daily Planet and suggests they become a couple, which Lois agrees to [d3]. Their relationship deepens further in Season 10, when they first sleep together in the episode "Harvest," Clark reveals his secret identity to Lois, and he proposes marriage [d1][d4]. In DC Comics, Clark proposed to Lois in the 1990s after revealing his identity as Superman, and the couple married in Superman: The Wedding Album in December 1996 [d5]. In a separate comics continuity, the couple also married in 1978 [d6]. Across all adaptations, their relationship is described as one of the most iconic in comic book and television history [d5][d1].
